description: Three separate offset and scale sections in one module, each polyphonic

params.text: Sets the voltage added to the signal of its section, -10V to 10V
Attenuates the voltage at the Ofs jack of its section before it is added to the Ofs knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets what the signal of its section is multiplied by, -10 to 10
Attenuates the voltage at the Scl jack of its section before it is added to the Scl knob, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The signal to be offset and scaled, one per channel
Modulates the added voltage, scaled by the Offset CV knob of its section
Modulates the multiplier, scaled by the Scale CV knob of its section

outputs.text: The signal from the In jack of its section multiplied by Scl and shifted by Ofs; with that In jack empty it carries the offset alone on one channel

notes: a section computes nothing at all until a cable is patched into its Out jack
menu: Offset Then Scale 1 — adds the offset before the multiplication in the first section
Offset Then Scale 2 — adds the offset before the multiplication in the second section
Offset Then Scale 3 — adds the offset before the multiplication in the third section
